summary_hover: Fogg's wager sparks nationwide debate and betting, which turns against him entirely when a police telegram accuses him of the bank robbery.
summary_detail: Phileas Fogg's departure becomes a national sensation, sparking intense debate, newspaper articles, and financial speculation across England. A highly critical article from the Royal Geographical Society causes his betting odds to plummet, leaving the elderly Lord Albemarle as his only backer. Public opinion collapses completely when the commissioner of police receives a telegram from Detective Fix in Suez, identifying Fogg as the bank robber.
